name: Atatürk ile Fotoğraf: Your Photo Next to the Portrait, for 29 Ekim and 10 Kasım
blurb: Atatürk ile fotoğraf is a yearly Turkish AI photo trend: around 29 Ekim (Republic Day) and 10 Kasım, people make a photo of themselves standing next to a framed portrait of Atatürk.

prompts.text: Using the uploaded photo of the person as the reference, turn it into a professional and realistic 29 October Republic Day photo shoot. Do not change the person's face, facial features, eyes, hair color, skin tone or natural expression in any way; keep their identity and real look completely. The person stands full body, upright and proud, just to the right of a large framed portrait on the wall, a little taller than the person: the well-known official portrait of the founder of the Republic of Türkiye from the 1930s: a dignified man in his fifties in a dark suit, a white shirt and a dark tie, his light hair swept back, a calm, steady, piercing gaze toward the viewer, in a classic studio portrait style, as a black-and-white photograph in a heavy dark wooden frame with a cream mat. The portrait is a still photograph inside its frame: it hangs straight and unchanged on the wall, it is not a person in the room, and the person does not touch it. Nobody else is in the room. The place is a bright, elegant hall with cream marble walls and a polished light stone floor. Warm sunlight falls through a tall window on the left and draws soft stripes of light across the floor and the wall. The person wears an elegant formal outfit that suits them: a tailored dark suit with a white shirt and a dark tie, or an elegant white or dark trouser suit, with a small red and white detail such as a pocket square or a lapel pin. Arms relaxed at the sides, body and face turned to the camera. Camera at chest height, a few steps back: the person from head to shoes and the whole framed portrait in frame. A warm, proud and emotional atmosphere. Professional photography, natural skin texture, realistic light and shadows, high resolution, an elegant composition. The photo must not look AI-generated; it should look as if a real photographer took it. Keep the person's age, body proportions and natural look. Do not recreate the face, do not add makeup, do not smooth the face, do not make the person look older or younger. No text, logo or watermark in the image, no name plate or caption under the portrait, no political party symbols. Vertical 9:16. Exactly one living person.

prompts.text: A calm, dignified moment in a bright marble hall on Republic Day. Keep the person's face, hair and outfit exactly as in the image. The person stands next to the large framed black-and-white portrait on the wall, breathes in, straightens up a little and takes one small, slow step toward the camera, then stands still with a small, proud smile. Warm sunlight moves softly across the stone floor and a few specks of dust float in the light. The camera pushes in very slowly. The framed portrait on the wall is a still photograph and stays perfectly still for the whole clip: the face in the portrait never moves, never blinks, never changes expression and never turns, and the portrait never comes to life. The person never touches the portrait. Nobody else enters. Audio: a soft, calm original piano melody and quiet room tone. No speech. One continuous shot, no cuts, five fingers on each hand, no morphing. No text, no logos, no watermark.
